app.title: Zero Cycle Cheat Sheet
anchor.An anchor in the bed position bre: An anchor in the bed position breaks crystal
anchor.The top anchor breaks crystal whe: The top anchor breaks crystal when detonated
setup.hybrid_desc: Setups where the bed is facing the north/south axis.
setup.modern_desc: Setups where the bed is facing the east/west axis.
setup.multiblock_desc: Has beds on both axes. If you choose to do 2 obby instead, one of the two bed positions is the main one and is listed as the setup type.
setup.multiblock_adjusted_desc: A standing block where you are standing diagonal to the two bed positions made by placing 3 obby.
key.title: Key
key.multiblock: Aligning yourself diagonally to two bed positions
key.heights: The first height is the triple staircase height, the second is the double staircase height
